Counter: Counters go up, and reset when the process restarts.
Gauge: Gauges are similar to Counters but a Gauge's value can be decreased.
Histogram: Histograms track sizes and frequency of events.
Summary: Summaries calculate percentiles of observed values.
metrics: You can remove all metrics by calling `register.clear()`. You can also remove a single metric by calling `register.removeSingleMetric(*name of metric*)`.
